hypotheses.F0_native_replay_is_exact: Maximum native replay logit error is at most 0.02.
hypotheses.F1_dense_write_subspaces_beat_native_ban: Rank-64 exact-write PCA beats the frozen 128-channel global bank by at least 0.15 full-logit fidelity in at least three layers.
hypotheses.F2_write_subspaces_beat_random_controls: Rank-64 exact-write PCA beats the p95 of eight equal-rank random residual subspaces in every layer.
hypotheses.F3_write_and_allocation_are_distinct_cau: Absolute rank-64 fidelity difference between exact-write and canonical-allocation PCA is at least 0.10 in at least two layers.
hypotheses.F4_late_write_is_compact: Layer-17 exact-write rank 16 reaches at least 0.80 full-logit fidelity.
hypotheses.F5_data_geometry_beats_static_weight_geo: Rank-64 exact-write PCA beats the leading rank-64 Down-weight output modes by at least 0.05 in at least three layers.
hypotheses.F6_rank_curves_are_monotone: Exact-write finite full-logit fidelity is nondecreasing from rank 4 through 128 in every layer.
